cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only answering the door. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery; I'll tell them where to put it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll measure after we've secured the bargain. Let me give them a yes first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod while I open the door. I'll sign before they get the tape measure out; we can work out the angle once it's ours.

reason: Give S06 a modest concrete role that determines task order, terms, timing or information handling. Keep exact Drive and B successive contributions; preserve all source and original evidence.
